description: Parametric curved-blade generator (scimitar family): swept diamond profile along an arc with taper, via EditableMesh
name: procedural-swept-blade
body:
Claude-authored generator - adapt parameters or the sweep path for new families (horns, tusks, curved staffs):
1. Profile ring: 4 verts (spine +Z t, side +X w, edge -Z t, side -X w) placed via cf:PointToWorldSpace - cross-section MUST be on the two axes NOT used by the sweep plane.
2. Handle: N straight rings along +Y (small radius).
3. Blade: sweep along an arc (radius R, angle A): pos = base * CFrame.new(cos(a)*R - R, sin(a)*R, 0), frame = pos * Angles(0,0,a); taper w,t toward a near-zero tip ring.
4. Skin ring pairs with quads (2 tris each, consistent winding), cap the base.
5. CreateMeshPartAsync -> CHECK part.Size for a degenerate axis -> capture -> iterate parameters -> save_mesh when approved.
Default params: segments 24, curveRadius 9, curveDeg 70, bladeWidth 0.55, bladeThick 0.09, handleLen 1.1. Scale down curveRadius+handleLen for a hand weapon.
